decisions.reason: The accelerator program is peripheral to the firm's core machinery and recycling business and likely falls short of performance aspirations, triggering problemistic search and reallocation of its resources.
Although it is a material rather than machinery, it is a strategic flagship and organisational slack allows continued development while results remain uncertain.
As a flagship decontamination plant close to the established offer, its results likely meet aspirations and justify retention.
The mobile mechanical recycling plant is directly aligned with the firm's core modular recycling technology and likely performs well relative to aspirations.
